title: Humanoid 2D and 3D editing
purpose: Verify that atlas painting, color picking, WebGL painting, history, and layer visibility share one humanoid skin document.

steps.title: Open the local studio
steps.expected: The studio loads in a fresh local browser context.

steps.title: Select the skin engine
steps.expected: The cuboid humanoid editor is selected.

steps.title: Wait for the 3D preview
steps.expected: The WebGL canvas is visible and ready for interaction.

steps.title: Click through the transparent head outer layer
steps.expected: The raycast skips the transparent outer texel and reaches the head base front face.

steps.title: Confirm transparent outer-layer picking
steps.expected: The reported semantic region is head / base / front while the outer layer remains enabled.

steps.title: Set a recognizable paint color
steps.expected: The pencil tool is active with magenta selected.

steps.title: Paint a mapped head-front atlas pixel
steps.expected: Atlas pixel 10,10 in the head/base/front region is painted.

steps.title: Confirm atlas painting
steps.expected: The editor reports a completed 2D paint stroke.

steps.title: Capture the atlas-to-preview update
steps.expected: Evidence shows the magenta atlas pixel reflected by the previews.

steps.title: Pick the painted color from the atlas
steps.expected: The color-picker tool is active.

steps.title: Pick the newly painted pixel
steps.expected: The editor picks #ff00ff and restores the pencil tool.

steps.title: Confirm color picking
steps.expected: The picked color is visible in the status bar.

steps.title: Paint directly on the 3D character
steps.expected: The center visible surface maps back to and paints an atlas pixel.

steps.title: Confirm 3D painting
steps.expected: The editor reports a completed 3D paint operation.

steps.title: Hide the outer layer
steps.expected: Outer-layer geometry and atlas pixels are hidden without changing the document.

steps.title: Capture the base-only view
steps.expected: Evidence shows the base layer without outer-layer geometry.

steps.title: Restore the outer layer
steps.expected: Outer-layer geometry and pixels are visible again.

steps.title: Undo the 3D paint
steps.expected: The most recent document edit is reverted in both views.

steps.title: Confirm shared history
steps.expected: The shared editor history reports the reversal.

steps.title: Separate camera orbit from surface editing
steps.expected: Pointer drags now control the camera without changing texture pixels.

steps.title: Rotate the 3D character toward its side
steps.expected: A real horizontal pointer drag exposes a side face.

steps.title: Confirm side rotation did not paint
steps.expected: The prior undo status remains unchanged after the drag, proving no paint action fired.

steps.title: Capture the side-facing 3D character
steps.expected: Evidence shows a materially different side-facing character angle.

steps.title: Rotate the 3D character toward its rear
steps.expected: A second horizontal pointer drag exposes the rear or opposite side.

steps.title: Confirm rear rotation did not paint
steps.expected: The prior undo status remains unchanged after the second horizontal drag.

steps.title: Capture the rear-facing 3D character
steps.expected: Evidence shows the rear or opposite side after the second horizontal drag.

steps.title: Tilt the 3D character to expose its top faces
steps.expected: A downward pointer drag tilts the character far enough to expose top faces.

steps.title: Confirm top rotation did not paint
steps.expected: The prior undo status remains unchanged after the top-face drag.

steps.title: Capture the exposed top faces
steps.expected: Evidence clearly shows top-facing cuboid surfaces.

steps.title: Tilt the 3D character to expose its bottom faces
steps.expected: An upward pointer drag tilts the character far enough to expose bottom faces.

steps.title: Confirm bottom rotation did not paint
steps.expected: The prior undo status remains unchanged after the bottom-face drag.

steps.title: Capture the exposed bottom faces
steps.expected: Evidence clearly shows bottom-facing cuboid surfaces.

steps.title: Reset the 3D character view
steps.expected: The character returns to the stable default viewing angle and zoom.

steps.title: Capture the reset 3D character
steps.expected: Evidence shows the default view is recoverable after free orbiting.
